text:
Evening gate crew,
Hardworking block behind us, one thing is left: departure prep
Hi team,

Quick pass from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. The desk is steady, and the main job now is keeping the handoff clean for the last wave of traveler files and pet notes. Please keep each carrier check calm and methodical, and make sure any service change gets written into the desk ledger right away. Safety takes priority over speed on every move, and the ground team needs clear notes before anything shifts from the staging area.

If you are covering a transfer, watch for label mix-ups, door latches, and any mismatch between the booking and the carrier tag. Keep the instructions simple when you speak with crews, and pass along anything that may affect a later handoff. If a traveler asks for reassurance, give a plain answer and stick to what you have confirmed. We are not chasing extra steps tonight, just clean work and steady follow-through. Buddy is already accounted for, and the file is in good shape.

Before you wrap, give the desk one last sweep for loose paperwork, missing signatures, and any item that needs a fresh note. If Lucas Morgan or Layla Morgan comes through your section, keep the exchange brief and direct, and let the next crew know what was done. The same goes for any other pet load that needs close attention. Clear notes help the next shift move faster, and that saves everyone trouble later.

Thanks for keeping the pace sharp and the care standard high. Finish strong and leave the desk ready for the next handoff.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
